children: Overview
China auto dealership's H1 revenue fell 23% yr/yr amid weak new vehicle sales
Net profit attributable to owners declined from last year but improved from prior half
Company cites intense price competition and weak consumer demand as key challenges
Outlook
Group will proactively consolidate its core vehicle sales and services business
Group will promote the commercial application services of embodied intelligence in a
phased manner and cultivate new business increments
Result Drivers
WEAK NEW VEHICLE SALES - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to significant drop in new vehicle sales of traditional fuel vehicle brands
INTENSE PRICE COMPETITION - Co cited fierce price competition and consumer wait-and-see attitude as factors pressuring sales and profit per vehicle
COST CONTROL MEASURES - Co reduced selling, administrative and finance expenses by 14% yr/yr
